subject: Important Update: New Business Hours
body: Dear valued customers, we wanted to inform you that starting next week, our store will have new operating hours. We will now be open from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Monday through Friday, and from 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM on Saturdays. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding. Thank you for your continued support.
